name: [GANGS REWORK] Ryujin
desc:
Ryujin is based on various martial art comics.

Whether you climb up to the top or give up on your path relies on your determination.

If you wish to see change logs, view upcoming updates, or interact with the community, join the game's server in the Social Links below.

To view the keybinds open up the settings. You can change keybinds as you like to fit your needs.
Mobile players can move the button's layout in settings as well.

To Get Access to the game,  buy the generation gamepass and join the server and make a ticket.
